{{Quote|There, the Royal Script still graces the Palazzo Reina and other buildings dating to the rule of Queen Tasia, and is used on street signs in the capital's Old Quarter.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan|<ref name="Word" />}}
The '''Palazzo Reina''' was a palace located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] that was built during the reign of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Elsinoré den Tasia]],<ref name="Word" /> which began by [[3950 BBY]] and ended in approximately [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The Palazzo was adorned with the [[Royal Script of Grizmallt]] and contained a room called the [[Heroine Hall]].<ref name="Word" />

Between [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] and [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Bigdate">[[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana's]] reign began after that of Queen [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]], who was in power during the events of "[[Crisis on Naboo]]," which took place in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] according to {{FactFile2014|57|EVA 1-2|Moralo Eval}}, and ended with her [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] according to {{Blog|holocron|22/comments|Movie Characters killed in the EU}}</ref> [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]]<ref name="Word" /> of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|queenapailana|Apailana, Queen}}</ref> made a state visit to Grizmallt during which she visited the Palazzo Reina, accompanied by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] senator was familiar with the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Writing/Legends|writing system]] [[Futhark/Legends|Futhark]], a descendant from the Royal Script of Grizmallt, leading him to famously misinterpret the name of the Heroine Hall as "Hero in Hell." The incident was recorded in "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]" by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]].<ref name="Word" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Palazzo Reina is a tip of the hat to Dan Wallace's would-be "Reina Tasia" retcon, which he describes in this blog post. Thus, one would probably read "Palazzo Reina" roughly as "Queen's Palace."|John Hazlett|<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blog|JSarek|8|Endnotes for The Written Word}}</ref>}}
The Palazzo Reina was mentioned in "[[The Written Word]]," an [[in-universe]] article written by [[John Hazlett]] and published on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]], a subscription feature on [[StarWars.com]],<ref name="Word" /> on [[March 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="Pub date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30796355|board=Literature|thread=Hyperspace New Short Fiction: JJM's "The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol" now online!!!|user=[[Nathan O'Keefe|Valin_Kenobi]]|date=2010-03-05|time=12:25 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171006225114/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/hyperspace-new-short-fiction-jjms-the-secret-journal-of-doctor-demagol-now-online.28297369/page-16}}</ref> Hazlett chose the name of the Palazzo in reference<ref name="Endnotes" /> to a backstory created by author [[Jason Fry]] for the cancelled reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Episode I]]'', where Fry planned to establish that Queen Tasia had seeded several colonies throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that used [[Wikipedia:Spanish language|Spanish]] influence in their naming conventions as an [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]].<ref name="Endnotes2">{{Blog|danwallace|34|Lostwords: The Essential Guide to Episode I}}</ref> As such, Hazlett specified that the Palazzo Reina could be translated as "Queen's Palace."<ref name="Endnotes" />
